job.company_name: Nxtwave Disruptive Technologies((Hiring for a Client)
job.job_description:
Role

Design, develop and deploy AI solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs),

Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and AI Agents while collaborating with cross-functional

teams.

Key Responsibilities

Build AI microservices using Python and FastAPI.
Develop and optimise RAG systems.
Integrate Google Generative AI SDK and OpenAI SDK.
Work with vector databases and MongoDB.
Write clean, scalable, maintainable code.
Collaborate with engineering and product teams.
Participate in design and code reviews.

Required Skills:

Python, FastAPI/Flask, RAG, embeddings, chunking, retrieval pipelines, Google Gen AI SDK,OpenAI SDK, Transformers, CNN, KNN, Pinecone/Qdrant, MongoDB, API security, authentication,data privacy.

Preferred Skills

LangChain, LlamaIndex, multimodal models, fine-tuning, hybrid retrieval, Docker, AWS, CI/CD,Redis, Node.js.

Soft Skills

Problem solving, ownership, collaboration, communication, fast learner, product mindset.
job.ai_reason: Strong production RAG, LangGraph, FastAPI, AWS experience; missing some vector DB and SDKs.
